title: Damas 1787: the governor of the Windward Islands to the minister of the Navy, cipher part read (Bouillé cipher of 1778)

steps.what: Cipher identified as Bouillé 1778 (margin note; 92% coverage; same formulas); key K6 of bouille1778 applied.
Frozen K6 on held-out letter no. 415 (C8 A 79 fol. 70) vs modern translation: 0.894 / 0.897 vs max 0.182 / 0.174.

Searched every key table of the same cipher in the repository (bouille1778/key.tsv, grassebouille1779/key.tsv, martinique1778/key_bouille.tsv, tentative.tsv, validation.tsv) for the 16 open numbers. 269, 686 and 190 have no value in any of them. 464 = ar is attested but gives no sense here. 493 = chacun appears only in the Grasse-Bouille key, from the sense of 'cent chacun', not from a gloss. 300, 741 and 831 have values only in grassebouille1779/key_codeM_K6.tsv, a different cipher (code M, 'cipher of 1777'), so they do not apply. 762 occurs once in martinique1778 f. 19 as an unresolved '[762]' in 'exis-[762]-es'. No restored word could be raised to probable.

Web search (7 Nov 2026) for a printed or online decipherment of the governor Damas's cipher letter of 2 November 1787 (ANOM COL C8 B 16 no. 61): nothing found; the only Damas hits concern 1790-91 (Hamilton College collection, a letter of La Luzerne of 12 June 1790).

outcome.method_basis: Same cipher as bouille1778; key rebuilt there from pencil glosses and validated on held-out letters.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 298/302 words read in their sense (281 certain, 5 probable, 12 restored, 4 unresolved). Recount of 5 Nov 2026: words restored from the sense are not counted as read, so 286 of 302 = 94.7% (certain + probable; 98.7% with the restored words). Earlier value: 0.987.

credits.note: cipher identified, letter deciphered with the bouille1778 key, English translation

texts.label: Damas to the minister of the Navy, Martinique, 2 Nov 1787 (cipher part)
texts.summary: If war with England came, Dominica should be seized; Damas lacks siege and field artillery, orders and funds; garrisons of the Windward Islands.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 31 Oct 2026: coherent prose throughout (Dominica, artillery wanted, Sainte-Lucie and Tobago without fortification, garrison strengths); 4 unresolved groups and 12 words restored from the sense, scattered, none leaves a sentence unreadable.

gaps.detail: not glossed in K6; no sibling key, print or DECODE record attests it (searched 7 Nov 2026), and a number that occurs once cannot be rebuilt from the text
